notes:
Summary: Halcyon operates a 15M+ asset media archive (video transcripts, scanned press, long-form feature text). Primary goal: enterprise search for journalists/editors + programmatic content discovery. Key constraints: very long documents (avg 3k-8k tokens), lots of near-duplicates, heavy tail of tiny notes.

Embeddings/indexing concerns:
- Need guidance on chunking: semantic scene-based chunking vs fixed-size overlapping windows. Customer leaning toward variable chunking (scene boundaries + metadata-aware) to reduce false positives.
- Scale: projected chunk count ~40M after chunking (current POC 250k assets -> ~750k chunks). Concerned about storage + ANN maintenance costs.
- Vector store options discussed: on-prem FAISS for privacy, managed vector DB for scaling. They flagged Milvus for hybrid cloud experiments.

Retrieval + reranker plan:
- Two-stage pipeline: 1) lightweight ANN (dense) + lexical hybrid retrieval to get top-N (N=200 recommended by SE), 2) cross-encoder reranker on top-K (K=20-50).
- Reranker tuning notes: tradeoff between K and latency/cost. Observed POC numbers: cross-encoder on top-200 -> unacceptable latency (~1.2s p95 under concurrency). Top-50 approach gives better quality/cost balance but still p95 ~600-800ms.
- Proposed optimization experiments: quantized cross-encoder, distill-to-lite-reranker (bi-encoder concatenation), progressive rerank (coarse-to-fine), caching heavy queries and prefix caching for recurring journalist queries.

Latency & SLOs:
- Customer target: 300-600ms median for interactive search, p95 target <=1s. For batch discovery workflows (>50 results) they accept higher latencies.
- First-pass ANN target: <=150-250ms. Rerank stage target: <=400ms for top-20 after optimizations.

Cost sensitivity:
- Target cost per interactive query: <$0.05 (including embeddings retrieval + reranker compute). Conservative ARR expectations mean tight cost controls necessary.
- Interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations: batching, KV/prefix caching, model quantization.

Security/compliance:
- Must support SSO (SAML), customer-managed KMS, audit logging, and EU data residency for certain assets. On-prem/private deployment preferred for PII archives.

Quotes/voice notes from stakeholders:
- "We need search that editors can trust — if the reranker returns noisy results, they lose faith." — Head of Archives
- "Cost per query has to be predictable; spikes ruin budget for newsroom projects." — CTO

Open technical questions (handoff to SE):
- Final recommendation on chunk size heuristics (tokens vs scene markers) given indexing blow-up estimates.
- Reranker model family and quantization strategy for sub-400ms p95.
- Vector store ops: snapshot / incremental reindex workflow for nightly ingest pipeline.

Files referenced: pricing deck (drive), security FAQ (drive), preliminary perf matrix (drive). Links in linked_drive_docs.

Short term next steps: deliver POC performance report with three reranker configs (baseline cross-encoder, quantized cross-encoder, progressive rerank) + cost/latency tradeoffs. AE to push security questionnaire to legal for final sign-off.
